title: Order Release to the Factory — Window Replacement Contracts
content:
# Order Release to the Factory — Window Replacement Contracts

**Production release standard**

The confirmed specifications are released to the factory once the contract is measured. The order may be released only after the required booking deposit has been received in full. For an in-home sale, the order may be released only once the cooling-off period counted from the contract signing date has fully passed. Business days are counted starting the day after the contract signing date, skipping Sundays and U.S. federal holidays, so Saturdays count as business days. Release on the last day of the cooling-off period is too early; the first permitted release date is the next calendar day. Showroom and virtual consultation sales carry no cooling-off wait. Release creates the factory production order for the contract.

## Release conditions

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| The contract is measured | The contract's status |
| The required booking deposit has been received in full | The payments recorded on this contract, its contract price |
| For an in-home sale only: the cooling-off period has fully passed | The contract's signing date and sales channel |

The period length is the series cooling-off period in business days.

## Cooling-off count, worked (hypothetical dates)

Take a 3-business-day period and an in-home contract signed on a hypothetical Thursday with no federal holiday in the following week. Business day 1 is the Friday, business day 2 is the Saturday, the Sunday is skipped, and business day 3 is the Monday. The Monday is the last day of the period, so release on the Monday is too early; the first permitted release date is the Tuesday.

| Release date | Permitted? |
|---|---|
| Monday (last day of the period) | No |
| Tuesday (the next calendar day) | Yes |

A federal holiday inside the period is skipped like a Sunday and pushes the last day later.

## Sales channel

A contract sold in a showroom or over a virtual consultation has no cooling-off wait; for it, release turns on the measured status and the full booking deposit.
